message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded directly from local CSV files via pd.read_csv with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks performed.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data-preparation code path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only filtering performed is `filter_sparse_samples` which removes zero-heavy time series for sparsity reasons, not as a statistical anomaly or outlier-based poisoning defense; no outlier detection or anomaly checks on training samples are implemented.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds models from scratch using Keras layers and loads data from CSV files, but there is no evidence of loading pretrained weights or serialized models with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision control.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training; the pipeline only filters sparse samples by zero-count percentage.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/val/test splits exist in DataHandler, there is no signing, hashing, or isolation mechanism protecting the held-out test set from leakage or tampering, and no use of multiple independent evaluation metrics is visible in the evaluation flow.

No detected input sanitization: The code loads and preprocesses data (filtering sparse samples, reindexing) but there are no explicit shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference data path.

No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks are visible on model outputs in the inference code path; the BrayCurtis loss adds a small epsilon (0.001) for numerical stability but that is not an output bounds check.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a time-series/graph neural network pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
